purpose: Resolve which font object/glyph array the actual wide renderer uses, and test whether the visibly corrupted legacy path still reads the original pre-relocation glyph array.
stage39k_result: The UV memcheck on the relocated glyph135 record hit only openseason_data_decode at 0x0881BF54. This is another loader false-positive and does NOT identify the visible renderer.
new_static_fact: Stage39J's RA 0x08972368 is BIAON+0x16E368, immediately after the actual wide renderer calls the proven Unicode lookup. In this function s2 is the font object and s0 is the UTF-16 cursor.

old_glyph_array_hypothesis.reason: The visible narrow renderer may retain the original glyph array pointer even though the production/wide font object was redirected to the relocated 847-record array.
